title: Imager and Alpaca image conversion omit RAW payload shape validation
description:
Received RAW data is cast and dimensions consumed without minimum header and overflow-safe pixel-span checks. BLOB registry validation does not validate image shape. Next: reuse guider-style header/signature/dimension/pixel-span checks and truncated-frame fixtures. Current audit also confirms platesolver preview at indigo_platesolver.c:63-100 does not validate payload size against RAW dimensions/type. Guider capture now validates shape/payload and is excluded from this current missing-check claim. Next: include platesolver preview in bounded image-consumer repair/retests.
